test_groupby_sample_balanced_groups: test groupby sample on balanced groups returns equal rows per group for n and frac parameters
test_groupby_sample_unbalanced_groups: test groupby sample on unbalanced groups returns equal rows per group regardless of group size
test_groupby_sample_n_and_frac_raises: test groupby sample raises ValueError when both n and frac parameters are specified
test_groupby_sample_invalid_n_raises: test groupby sample raises ValueError for negative or non-integer n values
test_groupby_sample_frac_gt_one_without_: test groupby sample raises ValueError when frac exceeds 1 without replace set to True
test_groupby_sample_oversample: test groupby sample with frac greater than 1 and replace True returns oversampled rows per group
test_groupby_sample_with_weights: test groupby sample with custom weights selects rows proportionally to specified weights
test_groupby_sample_with_selections: test groupby sample on selected columns returns only the specified columns
test_groupby_sample_with_empty_inputs: test groupby sample on empty dataframe returns the empty dataframe unchanged
